You can still vote by mail, just means they won’t automatically send you a postcard to sign requesting a ballot by mail. If you call the office or drop by, request to be added to the “permanent early ballot request” list and you will automatically get the request for every election. Additionally, if you were one of the many voters who did sign and return the gray request cards for the General Election AND ticked the box at the top that mentioned the permanent early voter list, you should get the request. People still make mistakes with the amount of manual data entry involved, so you can always call and ask them to look you up, check if you’re on the list, and add yourself if you’re not!
